# Templates

Copy the relevant template into its owning story and replace its placeholders. The linked workflow defines how to use it.

| Template | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Label audit](label-audit.md) | Fresh-context factual review prompt; follow the [production audit workflow](../production.md#audit-on-screen-facts-before-delivery). |
| [Pronunciation and voice direction](pronunciation.md) | Story vocabulary, proposed readings and listening evidence; follow the [voice guidance](../authoring.md#pronunciation-and-voice-direction). |
| [Pages workflow](pages.yml) | Story caller for the shared public [GitHub Pages workflow](../github-pages.md). |
| [YouTube metadata](youtube.json) | Input for [YouTube text preparation](../production.md#prepare-youtube-text). |

Return to the [documentation index](../README.md).
